description: K₂NaInP₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ibam space group. K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent In, and five equivalent P atoms. Both K-Na bond lengths are 3.53 Å. Both K-In bond lengths are 3.60 Å. There are a spread of K-P bond distances ranging from 3.37-3.69 Å. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent K and four equivalent P atoms. All Na-P bond lengths are 2.94 Å. In is bonded to four equivalent K and four equivalent P atoms to form distorted face-sharing InK₄P₄ tetrahedra. All In-P bond lengths are 2.66 Å. P is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to five equivalent K, two equivalent Na, and two equivalent In atoms.
